Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill

Unattributed9w

[(proc text) Order for Second Reading read. (proc text)]

Mr Chee Hong Tat1,820w

Mr Speaker, on behalf of the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance, I move, "That the Bill be now read a Second time." The Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill introduces a new legislative framework to facilitate dual listing arrangements on the Singapore Exchange (SGX) as part of the efforts to enhance the competitiveness of our equities market and strengthen Singapore's position as a leading financial centre. How this page was made

Built from the official Hansard record (Parliament of Singapore Official Reports). No news reporting was used. Briefs are written by software from the transcript and every key point carries the verbatim words it was drawn from.

  • Reports collected: 113 of about 115 (98%)

  • Speaker attribution: 95% of turns carry an explicit speaker tag
